nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs on push to main and on pull requests, executing the backend fast SQLite test suite, a Postgres-functional test suite against a postgres:16-alpine service container, and a frontend build-and-test job.
nodes.languageNotes: Splits backend tests into a fast SQLite-only suite (pytest -m 'not postgres') and a separate Postgres-functional suite (pytest -m postgres) run against a GitHub Actions service container, matching the project's SQLite-dev/Postgres-functional-parity testing strategy.

nodes.name: backend-fast
nodes.summary: CI job that installs backend Python dependencies and runs the fast pytest suite, excluding tests marked 'postgres', against the default SQLite setup.

nodes.name: backend-postgres
nodes.summary: CI job that spins up a postgres:16-alpine service container with health checks and runs the pytest suite marked 'postgres' against it, providing Postgres-functional parity testing.

nodes.name: frontend
nodes.summary: CI job that installs frontend dependencies with npm ci, builds the Vite app, and runs the frontend test suite.
